headline: 30,440 million pesos allocated for water infrastructure in Baja California
summary: Baja California has allocated 30,440 million pesos to water infrastructure projects. The investment aims to extend access to drinking water to more than 519,000 residents.
why: Baja California is a northwestern Mexican state bordering the United States, and public infrastructure spending there affects regional construction and utilities activity.
original_headline: Destinan 30,440 millones de pesos para infraestructura hídrica en Baja California
